'''Morvis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], she was in her third term. Her husband [[Herron Morvis]] was the Director of the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]] and her son was [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dallan Morvis]].
